name: Hungry Town Shop Manager
summary:
Welcome to Hungry Town Shop Manager, a fun and relaxing shop management simulation where you build and expand the most popular food store in town.

Start with a small neighborhood shop and turn it into a thriving business. Stock shelves with fresh food, snacks, drinks, and everyday essentials. Keep customers happy by serving them quickly, managing inventory, and ensuring your store is always ready for the next rush.
